mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL (current value) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as elevated inflation erodes corporate profit margins and increases risk aversion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where CPIAUCSL is above 200 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals an impending monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE > 5.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) combined with a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0) indicates an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 210), the S&P 500 tends to have negative forward returns over the next 60 days due to rising interest rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher GDP (GDPC1) level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days, as stronger economic growth supports corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where GDPC1 is above 12000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500, it signals a weakening housing market and economic slowdown, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as investors anticipate policy responses.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where HOUST < 500 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the labor force (PAYEMS < 130000) combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a deteriorating labor market and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by RSAFS > 350000 and CPIAUCSL > 215), the S&P 500 tends to have negative forward returns over the next 60 days due to overvaluation and increased risk of a policy-induced slowdown.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
